extracted.name: The Ultimate Margarita
extracted.description: The name says it all--quality ingredients yield the best margarita!
ingredient_lines: 0.5 fluid ounce Gran Gala Triple Orange Liqueur
1 fluid ounce agave nectar or simple syrup
instruction_lines: Shake together all ingredients with ice and strain into a margarita glass.
Optional: rub the cut side of a lime on the glass rim and dip it into salt; and add a lime wedge to the rim of the glass as a garnish.
